parameters.query: ={{ "WITH project AS (SELECT id FROM projects WHERE slug = 'shakespeare-is-boring' LIMIT 1) INSERT INTO entities (project_id, entity_type, name, description, raw_data, notes, status, first_seen_at, last_seen_at) SELECT project.id, 'generated_video', 'Veo render — Shot ' || COALESCE($json.body.shotNumber, 0) || ' — ' || COALESCE(($json.body.shotTitle || '').replace(/'/g, \"''\"), 'Untitled shot'), 'Generated from Veo Studio for ' || COALESCE(($json.body.projectTitle || '').replace(/'/g, \"''\"), 'Shakespeare is Boring') || '. Prompt: ' || COALESCE(($json.body.prompt || '').replace(/'/g, \"''\"), ''), CAST('" + JSON.stringify($json.body || {}).replace(/'/g, \"''\") + "' AS jsonb), COALESCE(($json.body.exportFileName || '').replace(/'/g, \"''\"), ''), 'active', NOW(), NOW() FROM project;" }}
